panel.label: Experimental
panel.name: experimental
panel.string: [ENTRIES] textures, [USED] of [MAX] GB. This session: [LOADS] loaded, [STORES] stored, [REMOVED] removed.
panel.text: Experimental and diagnostic settings. Some changes require a viewer restart.

text.name: experimental_preset_label
text.tool_tip: Presets hold every setting on the Photo, Effects, Rendering, Shadows and Performance tabs. The General, Textures, Avatar and Five tabs are not included.

combo_box.name: experimental_preset_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Presets hold every setting on the Photo, Effects, Rendering, Shadows and Performance tabs; settings a preset doesn't list are set to their defaults when it is loaded. The General, Textures, Avatar and Five tabs are not included. Built-in presets can't be changed or deleted; Cancel undoes a loaded preset.

button.label: Load
button.name: experimental_preset_load
button.tool_tip: Set the settings of the Photo, Effects, Rendering, Shadows and Performance tabs from the selected preset. Settings it doesn't list go back to their defaults. Cancel undoes it.

button.label: Save as...
button.name: experimental_preset_save
button.tool_tip: Save the current settings of the Photo, Effects, Rendering, Shadows and Performance tabs as a new preset, or replace one of your own.

button.label: Delete
button.name: experimental_preset_delete
button.tool_tip: Delete the selected preset. Only your own presets can be deleted.

check_box.label: Only connect to adjacent regions
check_box.name: render_neighbor_adjacent_only
check_box.tool_tip: Only connect to the current and adjacent regions, plus the teleport target, to limit neighbor loading

check_box.label: Release regions that are no longer adjacent (experimental)
check_box.name: release_non_adjacent_regions
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Releases a neighbor region once it has been non-adjacent for 5 seconds, by closing that region's connection only. Requires 'Only connect to adjacent regions'. Logged under FSRegionRelease.

check_box.label: Fetch offline messages while online
check_box.name: fetch_offline_ims
check_box.tool_tip: Periodically request offline instant messages while online

check_box.label: Protect privacy while RLVa attachments load
check_box.name: rlva_experimental_login_privacy
check_box.tool_tip: Temporarily hide the world, names, location, maps, and nearby avatars during login; restrictions not resent by attachments are released after loading or a safety timeout

text.name: resolution_multiplier_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Renders the scene at this multiple of the window size and filters it down: above 1 smooths edges and fine detail (2 is the cleanest), below 1 renders faster at lower resolution. Above 1 costs a lot of GPU time and memory, and sun shadow maps grow with it. Ignored while the resolution divisor debug setting is above 1.

spinner.name: resolution_multiplier
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Renders the scene at this multiple of the window size and filters it down: above 1 smooths edges and fine detail (2 is the cleanest), below 1 renders faster at lower resolution. Above 1 costs a lot of GPU time and memory, and sun shadow maps grow with it. Ignored while the resolution divisor debug setting is above 1.

check_box.label: Snapshots wait for textures to finish loading
check_box.name: snapshot_wait_for_textures
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Before the snapshot floater captures, wait until the textures on screen have loaded at the resolution the picture needs. Snapshots larger than the window ask for sharper textures than the screen does.

text.name: snapshot_texture_wait_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Longest time a snapshot waits for textures before capturing anyway.

spinner.name: snapshot_texture_wait
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Longest time a snapshot waits for textures before capturing anyway.

check_box.label: Screen space reflections
check_box.name: ssr_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Reflect what is on screen in shiny surfaces, on top of the reflection probes.

text.name: ssr_iterations_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many steps each reflection ray takes looking for what it hits. More steps find more of the scene and further away. Default 25.

spinner.name: ssr_iterations
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many steps each reflection ray takes looking for what it hits. More steps find more of the scene and further away. Default 25.

text.name: ssr_ray_step_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Length of the first reflection ray step. Smaller steps give more precise reflections close to the surface but reach less far for the same number of steps. Default 0.1.

spinner.name: ssr_ray_step
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Length of the first reflection ray step. Smaller steps give more precise reflections close to the surface but reach less far for the same number of steps. Default 0.1.

text.name: ssr_glossy_samples_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Rays traced per pixel for reflections on rough surfaces. More rays give smoother, less noisy glossy reflections. Default 4.

spinner.name: ssr_glossy_samples
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Rays traced per pixel for reflections on rough surfaces. More rays give smoother, less noisy glossy reflections. Default 4.

text.name: ssr_distance_bias_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How close a ray has to come to a surface to count as hitting it. Larger values fill in gaps in reflections but can smear them. Default 0.015.

spinner.name: ssr_distance_bias
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How close a ray has to come to a surface to count as hitting it. Larger values fill in gaps in reflections but can smear them. Default 0.015.

text.name: ssr_reject_bias_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Depth difference below which a reflection hit is thrown away as the surface reflecting itself. Raise it if reflections show speckles on flat surfaces. Default 0.001.

spinner.name: ssr_reject_bias
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Depth difference below which a reflection hit is thrown away as the surface reflecting itself. Raise it if reflections show speckles on flat surfaces. Default 0.001.

check_box.label: Hierarchical screen space reflections
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderssrhiz
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Traces screen space reflections through a depth pyramid: longer, more accurate reflections at similar or lower cost, no leaking through thin objects, and a smooth fade into the reflection probes where the screen has no information. Rebuilds shaders.

check_box.label: Cone-traced glossy reflections
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderssrconetrace
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Glossy surfaces trace one reflection ray and blur its result by the surface's roughness, instead of averaging several scattered rays. Smoother and cheaper; needs hierarchical screen space reflections.

text.name: fs_fsrenderssrhizsteps_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Most steps one hierarchical reflection ray may take. Each step skips a whole empty region, so 32 reaches across the screen; more finds reflections behind objects more often at higher cost.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderssrhizsteps
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Most steps one hierarchical reflection ray may take. Each step skips a whole empty region, so 32 reaches across the screen; more finds reflections behind objects more often at higher cost.

text.name: fs_fsrenderssrthickness_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far a reflection ray may pass behind a surface and still count as hitting it. Raise if reflections of solid objects have holes; lower if thin objects (posts, railings) smear into the reflection behind them.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderssrthickness
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far a reflection ray may pass behind a surface and still count as hitting it. Raise if reflections of solid objects have holes; lower if thin objects (posts, railings) smear into the reflection behind them.

text.name: fs_fsrenderssredgefade_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Share of the screen over which reflections fade into the reflection probes as they near the screen edge. 0 turns the fade off.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderssredgefade
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Share of the screen over which reflections fade into the reflection probes as they near the screen edge. 0 turns the fade off.

check_box.label: Sun rays (light shafts)
check_box.name: sun_rays
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Light scattered in the air, broken into shafts wherever something casts a sun shadow: through trees, windows, gaps in buildings. Needs sun shadows on. The sun shadow distance setting limits how far they reach.

text.name: sun_rays_strength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness of the sun rays. Moonlight rays are drawn much fainter than this.

spinner.name: sun_rays_strength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness of the sun rays. Moonlight rays are drawn much fainter than this.

text.name: sun_rays_density_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much the air scatters light. Higher values give thicker, hazier rays. With Follow the sky's haze on, the sky's own haze scales it.

spinner.name: sun_rays_density
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much the air scatters light. Higher values give thicker, hazier rays. With Follow the sky's haze on, the sky's own haze scales it.

text.name: sun_rays_anisotropy_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 scatters light evenly in every direction. Higher values concentrate the rays around the sun, the way haze looks when facing the light.

spinner.name: sun_rays_anisotropy
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 scatters light evenly in every direction. Higher values concentrate the rays around the sun, the way haze looks when facing the light.

text.name: sun_rays_distance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far from the camera the air is lit.

spinner.name: sun_rays_distance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far from the camera the air is lit.

text.name: sun_rays_steps_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Samples taken along each ray. Each pixel starts its samples at a slightly different point and the result is smoothed, so low counts give soft grain rather than bands. More gives cleaner shafts at more GPU time.

spinner.name: sun_rays_steps
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Samples taken along each ray. Each pixel starts its samples at a slightly different point and the result is smoothed, so low counts give soft grain rather than bands. More gives cleaner shafts at more GPU time.

text.name: sun_rays_resolution_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Resolution the rays are computed at. 0.5 is a quarter of the pixels and looks nearly the same, since the rays are soft and are filled back in along object edges.

spinner.name: sun_rays_resolution
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Resolution the rays are computed at. 0.5 is a quarter of the pixels and looks nearly the same, since the rays are soft and are filled back in along object edges.

text.name: sun_rays_height_falloff_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How quickly the air thins out above the camera, per meter, and thickens below it (up to 4 times). 0 keeps it even. At 0.005 the rays are half as dense about 140 m above you, so they gather low down instead of washing over the sky.

spinner.name: sun_rays_height_falloff
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How quickly the air thins out above the camera, per meter, and thickens below it (up to 4 times). 0 keeps it even. At 0.005 the rays are half as dense about 140 m above you, so they gather low down instead of washing over the sky.

check_box.label: Colour from the sky
check_box.name: sun_rays_sky_color
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the rays with the current sky's sun or moon light, turning warmer and dimmer as the light nears the horizon, like the rest of the scene. Off uses only the tint colour.

text.name: sun_rays_tint_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour multiplied into the rays. White leaves them the sky's colour; with sky colour off, this is their colour.

color_swatch.name: sun_rays_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour multiplied into the rays. White leaves them the sky's colour; with sky colour off, this is their colour.

check_box.label: Follow the sky's haze
check_box.name: sun_rays_sky_haze
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Hazier skies give thicker rays: the haze density above is scaled by the current sky's haze density, between half and twice.

check_box.label: Moonlight rays
check_box.name: sun_rays_moon
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. While the sun is down, draw much fainter rays from the moon, scaled by its brightness in the sky settings.

check_box.label: HDR bloom
check_box.name: bloom
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Bright parts of the image glow onto their surroundings: sun on water, lamps, emissive surfaces. Works from the full brightness range of the scene, separately from the classic glow.

text.name: bloom_strength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much bloom is added.

spinner.name: bloom_strength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much bloom is added.

text.name: bloom_threshold_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness above which light blooms. 1 is full white on screen, lower values let more of the image bloom.

spinner.name: bloom_threshold
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness above which light blooms. 1 is full white on screen, lower values let more of the image bloom.

text.name: bloom_knee_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How gradually bloom fades in below the threshold.

spinner.name: bloom_knee
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How gradually bloom fades in below the threshold.

text.name: bloom_levels_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Blur levels, each twice as wide as the last. More gives a wider, softer bloom.

spinner.name: bloom_levels
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Blur levels, each twice as wide as the last. More gives a wider, softer bloom.

check_box.label: Colour grading
check_box.name: color_grade
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Adjust the colour of the finished image, after tone mapping, like a photo editor.

text.name: color_grade_temperature_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 6500 is neutral. Lower values warm the image toward orange, higher values cool it toward blue.

spinner.name: color_grade_temperature
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 6500 is neutral. Lower values warm the image toward orange, higher values cool it toward blue.

text.name: color_grade_tint_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Positive values shift the image toward green, negative toward magenta.

spinner.name: color_grade_tint
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Positive values shift the image toward green, negative toward magenta.

text.name: color_grade_lift_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Raises the blacks (positive, faded look) or crushes them (negative), without moving white.

spinner.name: color_grade_lift
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Raises the blacks (positive, faded look) or crushes them (negative), without moving white.

text.name: color_grade_gamma_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightens (above 1) or darkens (below 1) the midtones, leaving black and white in place.

spinner.name: color_grade_gamma
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightens (above 1) or darkens (below 1) the midtones, leaving black and white in place.

text.name: color_grade_gain_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Scales the image toward white.

spinner.name: color_grade_gain
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Scales the image toward white.

text.name: color_grade_contrast_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Contrast around mid grey.

spinner.name: color_grade_contrast
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Contrast around mid grey.

text.name: color_grade_saturation_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 is black and white.

spinner.name: color_grade_saturation
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 is black and white.

text.name: color_grade_vibrance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Saturates muted colours more than ones that are already strong, which keeps skin from going orange. Negative values mute them.

spinner.name: color_grade_vibrance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Saturates muted colours more than ones that are already strong, which keeps skin from going orange. Negative values mute them.

text.name: color_grade_shadow_tint_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the shadows are tinted toward. White leaves them alone.

color_swatch.name: color_grade_shadow_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the shadows are tinted toward. White leaves them alone.

text.name: color_grade_highlight_tint_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the highlights are tinted toward. White leaves them alone.

color_swatch.name: color_grade_highlight_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Colour the highlights are tinted toward. White leaves them alone.

text.name: color_grade_split_balance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Moves the line between the shadow and highlight tints. Positive gives the highlight tint more of the image.

spinner.name: color_grade_split_balance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Moves the line between the shadow and highlight tints. Positive gives the highlight tint more of the image.

text.name: color_grade_lut_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. A .cube file, as exported by most grading tools, or a PNG strip (size*size by size pixels, green increasing downward). A full path, or just the file name of one in the luts folder inside your user settings folder. Leave empty for none.

line_editor.name: color_grade_lut
line_editor.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. A .cube file, as exported by most grading tools, or a PNG strip (size*size by size pixels, green increasing downward). A full path, or just the file name of one in the luts folder inside your user settings folder. Leave empty for none.

text.name: color_grade_lut_strength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much of the lookup table is applied.

spinner.name: color_grade_lut_strength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much of the lookup table is applied.

text.name: chromatic_aberration_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Red and blue fringes that grow toward the edges of the frame, as with a real lens. The value is the fringe width at the corners. 0 is off.

spinner.name: chromatic_aberration
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Red and blue fringes that grow toward the edges of the frame, as with a real lens. The value is the fringe width at the corners. 0 is off.

check_box.label: Only where depth of field blurs
check_box.name: chromatic_aberration_dof
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Limit chromatic aberration to out of focus areas, scaled by how blurred they are. Needs depth of field on.

text.name: lens_flare_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Flare, glare and ghosts when the sun or moon is in view and not hidden behind anything. 0 is off.

spinner.name: lens_flare
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Flare, glare and ghosts when the sun or moon is in view and not hidden behind anything. 0 is off.

text.name: film_grain_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Film grain, strongest in the midtones. 0 is off.

spinner.name: film_grain
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Film grain, strongest in the midtones. 0 is off.

text.name: film_grain_size_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Size of the grain.

spinner.name: film_grain_size
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Size of the grain.

check_box.label: Water caustics
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderwatercaustics
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Moving patterns of sunlight focused by the waves on the sea floor, submerged objects and avatars standing in the water. They fade with depth and with a low sun. Costs a little in the sun lighting pass, only on pixels under the water.

text.name: fs_fsrenderwatercausticsstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness of the caustics, as a fraction of the direct sunlight.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderwatercausticsstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Brightness of the caustics, as a fraction of the direct sunlight.

text.name: fs_fsrenderwatercausticsscale_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Size of the caustic cells in metres.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderwatercausticsscale
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Size of the caustic cells in metres.

text.name: fs_fsrenderwatercausticsspeed_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How fast the caustics move. 0 freezes them.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderwatercausticsspeed
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How fast the caustics move. 0 freezes them.

check_box.label: Shoreline foam
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderwaterfoam
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. A soft, moving band of foam where the water meets land, rocks, boats and anything else standing in it, seen from above and below the surface. Needs transparent water.

text.name: fs_fsrenderwaterfoamwidth_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Water depth in metres at which the foam band ends.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderwaterfoamwidth
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Water depth in metres at which the foam band ends.

text.name: fs_fsrenderwaterfoamstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Opacity of the foam.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderwaterfoamstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Opacity of the foam.

check_box.label: Sun glints on water
check_box.name: fs_fsrendersunglints
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Sparkling highlights where the waves catch the sun, the glitter around the sun's reflection. They follow the sun colour and sun shadows and flicker as the waves move. Costs a little on water pixels only. Changing it rebuilds the shaders.

text.name: fs_fsrendersunglintsintensity_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How bright the sun glints are.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendersunglintsintensity
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How bright the sun glints are.

text.name: fs_fsrendersunglintsdensity_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many sun glints there are.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendersunglintsdensity
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many sun glints there are.

check_box.label: Lens dirt
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderbloomlensdirt
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Smudges and specks on the lens that light up where bloom falls on them, as with bright lights or the sun in a camera. Needs bloom.

text.name: fs_fsrenderbloomlensdirtstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much the dirt adds to the bloom where it lies.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderbloomlensdirtstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much the dirt adds to the bloom where it lies.

check_box.label: Local tone mapping
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderlocaltonemap
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Evens out large differences in brightness, such as a room beside a bright window, while keeping fine detail and contrast. Applied before the tonemapper. Costs a small quarter resolution pass.

text.name: fs_fsrenderexposurespeedtobright_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How fast auto exposure adjusts when the scene gets brighter, as a multiple of the normal speed. 1 is the default.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderexposurespeedtobright
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How fast auto exposure adjusts when the scene gets brighter, as a multiple of the normal speed. 1 is the default.

text.name: fs_fsrenderexposurespeedtodark_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How fast auto exposure adjusts when the scene gets darker, as a multiple of the normal speed. Real eyes adapt to darkness more slowly than to light. 1 is the default.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderexposurespeedtodark
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How fast auto exposure adjusts when the scene gets darker, as a multiple of the normal speed. Real eyes adapt to darkness more slowly than to light. 1 is the default.

text.name: fs_fsrenderexposurecenterweight_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much auto exposure favours the middle of the screen. 0 meters the whole view; 1 only the centre, so a bright sky at the edges doesn't darken a portrait.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderexposurecenterweight
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much auto exposure favours the middle of the screen. 0 meters the whole view; 1 only the centre, so a bright sky at the edges doesn't darken a portrait.

text.name: fs_fsrenderexposurerangelimit_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Limits how far auto exposure can brighten or darken, in stops either side of the middle of its range. 0 means no limit.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderexposurerangelimit
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Limits how far auto exposure can brighten or darken, in stops either side of the middle of its range. 0 means no limit.

text.name: fs_fsrenderlocaltonemapstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much large scale brightness differences are reduced. 0 leaves them; 1 evens them out completely.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderlocaltonemapstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much large scale brightness differences are reduced. 0 leaves them; 1 evens them out completely.

text.name: fs_fsrenderlocaltonemapdetail_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Multiplies the fine detail kept on top of the evened out lighting. 1 keeps it as is; higher values add local contrast but can show halos at bright edges.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderlocaltonemapdetail
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Multiplies the fine detail kept on top of the evened out lighting. 1 keeps it as is; higher values add local contrast but can show halos at bright edges.

check_box.label: Debanding dither
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderdeband
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Removes the visible steps (banding) in skies, fog and soft gradients by adding an invisible fine grain of one colour step before the image is reduced to 8 bits. Replaces the viewer's own present noise. Practically free.

text.name: fs_fsrenderdebandstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Amplitude of the debanding dither in colour steps. 1 is correct for 8 bit output; raise it only if some banding remains, it makes the grain visible.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderdebandstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Amplitude of the debanding dither in colour steps. 1 is correct for 8 bit output; raise it only if some banding remains, it makes the grain visible.

panel.name: experimental_rendering_settings

check_box.label: Render alpha-blended objects into shadow maps
check_box.name: render_alpha_blend_shadows
check_box.tool_tip: Render alpha-blended objects into shadow maps; animated transparent effects may be expensive shadow casters

check_box.label: Use opaque depth for the RLVa debug sphere
check_box.name: rlva_debug_sphere_opaque_depth
check_box.tool_tip: Use a pre-alpha depth snapshot so alpha wearables do not punch through the RLVa sphere effect

check_box.label: Disable AMD shader binary cache
check_box.name: render_amd_disable_shader_cache
check_box.tool_tip: Bypass viewer shader binary caching on Windows AMD; restart required

check_box.label: Disable AMD texture and media threading
check_box.name: render_amd_disable_texture_threading
check_box.tool_tip: Force main-thread texture and media uploads on Windows AMD; restart required

check_box.label: Use direct rigged-mesh normals
check_box.name: render_rigged_direct_normals
check_box.tool_tip: Transform rigged mesh normals and tangents as directions; restart required

check_box.label: Use local-origin rigged mesh skinning
check_box.name: render_rigged_local_origin
check_box.tool_tip: Test avatar-root-relative rigged mesh skinning; restart required

check_box.label: Use precise rigged-mesh shader math
check_box.name: render_rigged_precise_math
check_box.tool_tip: Test precise arithmetic and invariant positions in skinning shaders; restart required and may reduce performance

text.name: shadow_cull_mode_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How the objects drawn into the 4 sun shadow maps are found. Once for all maps saves CPU time, each map is then filtered down to what reaches it.

combo_box.name: shadow_cull_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How the objects drawn into the 4 sun shadow maps are found. Once for all maps saves CPU time, each map is then filtered down to what reaches it.

check_box.label: Only draw avatars and attachments into shadow maps they reach
check_box.name: shadow_cull_bridges_per_cascade
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. When casters are found once for all maps, test avatars, attachments and animesh against each sun shadow map by their position in the world, instead of drawing them into maps they don't reach.

text.name: shadow_min_caster_texels_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Objects smaller than this many shadow map pixels are not drawn into that sun shadow map. Measured against the map's most detailed pixels, so their shadow could not show anyway. Avatars, attachments, trees and terrain always cast. 0 draws everything.

spinner.name: shadow_min_caster_texels
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Objects smaller than this many shadow map pixels are not drawn into that sun shadow map. Measured against the map's most detailed pixels, so their shadow could not show anyway. Avatars, attachments, trees and terrain always cast. 0 draws everything.

text.name: shadow_max_distance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far sun and moon shadows reach. The shadow maps are spread over this distance, so a shorter one makes nearby shadows much sharper, at the cost of no shadows further away. Reflection probes keep the full distance.

spinner.name: shadow_max_distance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far sun and moon shadows reach. The shadow maps are spread over this distance, so a shorter one makes nearby shadows much sharper, at the cost of no shadows further away. Reflection probes keep the full distance.

text.name: shadow_splits_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many of the sun shadow maps are drawn. Each covers a further stretch of the shadow distance, so fewer maps leave distant shadows out but save a render pass each.

combo_box.name: shadow_splits
combo_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many of the sun shadow maps are drawn. Each covers a further stretch of the shadow distance, so fewer maps leave distant shadows out but save a render pass each.

text.name: shadow_far_cascade_interval_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Render the two far sun shadow maps every this many frames instead of every frame (the furthest every twice this). Moving the camera, turning it or the sun moving re-renders them at once. 1 renders every frame.

panel.text: Update far sun shadows every N frames

spinner.name: shadow_far_cascade_interval
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Render the two far sun shadow maps every this many frames instead of every frame (the furthest every twice this). Moving the camera, turning it or the sun moving re-renders them at once. 1 renders every frame.

text.name: shadow_far_cascade_resolution_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Resolution of the two far sun shadow maps relative to the near ones (0.25 - 1). Far shadows cover a lot of ground per texel and blur anyway.

spinner.name: shadow_far_cascade_resolution
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Resolution of the two far sun shadow maps relative to the near ones (0.25 - 1). Far shadows cover a lot of ground per texel and blur anyway.

text.name: shadow_far_cascade_min_caster_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Multiplies RenderShadowMinCasterTexels for the two far sun shadow maps, so small objects far away stop casting sooner (1 - 16). Needs RenderShadowMinCasterTexels above 0.

panel.text: Far sun shadows skip small objects (x)

spinner.name: shadow_far_cascade_min_caster
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Multiplies RenderShadowMinCasterTexels for the two far sun shadow maps, so small objects far away stop casting sooner (1 - 16). Needs RenderShadowMinCasterTexels above 0.

text.name: avatar_shadow_distance_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Avatars and animesh further than this from the camera, with their attachments, cast no shadow. 0 for no limit. Your own avatar always casts.

spinner.name: avatar_shadow_distance
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Avatars and animesh further than this from the camera, with their attachments, cast no shadow. 0 for no limit. Your own avatar always casts.

text.name: spot_shadow_update_interval_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. While a projector light and its settings stay unchanged, re-render its shadow only every this many frames. Things moving in its light update with that delay. 1 renders every frame.

panel.text: Update still projector shadows every N frames

spinner.name: spot_shadow_update_interval
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. While a projector light and its settings stay unchanged, re-render its shadow only every this many frames. Things moving in its light update with that delay. 1 renders every frame.

check_box.label: Faster sun shadow filtering away from shadow edges
check_box.name: shadow_fast_filter
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Sample sun shadows with 3 lookups instead of 5 where the area is clearly fully lit or fully shadowed, and only do all 5 near shadow edges. Rebuilds shaders when changed.

check_box.label: Stabilise sun shadow edges while the camera moves
check_box.name: shadow_texel_snap
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Snap each sun shadow cascade to whole shadow map texels, so shadow edges stay put instead of crawling and shimmering while the camera moves or turns. Costs almost nothing.

check_box.label: Enhanced specular anti-aliasing
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderspecularaa
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Reduces sparkle and shimmer on shiny PBR and legacy material surfaces at a distance and on detailed normal maps by widening highlights where normal detail is too fine for the pixel.

text.name: fs_fsrenderspecularaastrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How strongly normal variation between pixels softens highlights. Higher removes more sparkle but makes distant shiny surfaces duller.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderspecularaastrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How strongly normal variation between pixels softens highlights. Higher removes more sparkle but makes distant shiny surfaces duller.

text.name: fs_fsrenderspecularaathreshold_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Upper limit on how much roughness the filter may add.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderspecularaathreshold
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Upper limit on how much roughness the filter may add.

check_box.label: Ground-truth ambient occlusion (GTAO)
check_box.name: fs_fsrendergtao
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Replaces the classic screen-space ambient occlusion with a more accurate horizon-based method. Needs Ambient Occlusion enabled. Costs more GPU time.

text.name: fs_fsrendergtaoradius_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far around each point GTAO looks for occluders, in metres.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendergtaoradius
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far around each point GTAO looks for occluders, in metres.

text.name: fs_fsrendergtaointensity_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Darkens (higher) or lightens (lower) the occlusion. 1 is the physically based amount.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendergtaointensity
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Darkens (higher) or lightens (lower) the occlusion. 1 is the physically based amount.

text.name: fs_fsrendergtaoslices_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Directions sampled per pixel, 1 to 4. More is smoother and slower. Changing it rebuilds the lighting shader.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendergtaoslices
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Directions sampled per pixel, 1 to 4. More is smoother and slower. Changing it rebuilds the lighting shader.

check_box.label: Half-resolution GTAO
check_box.name: fs_fsrendergtaohalfres
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Computes GTAO once per 2x2 pixels and upsamples it along depth and normal edges, so it does not bleed across silhouettes. Saves most of the GTAO cost; very fine creases get slightly softer.

check_box.label: Dynamic resolution
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolution
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. When the frame rate drops below the target because the graphics card is the bottleneck, render the 3D scene at a lower resolution and upscale it with sharpening. The UI stays sharp. Has no effect while a resolution divisor or multiplier is set.

text.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolutiontargetfps_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Frame rate to keep. 0 uses your frame rate limit if one is set, else 60.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolutiontargetfps
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Frame rate to keep. 0 uses your frame rate limit if one is set, else 60.

text.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolutionminscale_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Lowest scene resolution allowed, as a fraction of the window size. Lower is faster but softer.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolutionminscale
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Lowest scene resolution allowed, as a fraction of the window size. Lower is faster but softer.

text.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolutionsharpness_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Extra sharpening when the scene is upscaled. 0 keeps the plain bicubic filter.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolutionsharpness
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Extra sharpening when the scene is upscaled. 0 keeps the plain bicubic filter.

text.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolutioninterval_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Minimum time between resolution changes. Each change causes a brief hitch.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderdynamicresolutioninterval
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Minimum time between resolution changes. Each change causes a brief hitch.

check_box.label: Subsurface scattering on avatar skin
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderskinsss
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Softer, more lifelike skin under strong light: light bleeds slightly through and around the skin, with a reddish falloff at shadow edges and around ears and fingers. Applies to avatar surfaces weighted by how skin-like their colour is. Needs HDR. Turning it on or off rebuilds shaders.

text.name: fs_fsrenderskinsssstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much of the diffused light replaces the lit skin. Only the light is diffused: skin texture and highlights stay sharp, so 1 (the physical look) does not blur the face. 0 turns the scattering off.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderskinsssstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much of the diffused light replaces the lit skin. Only the light is diffused: skin texture and highlights stay sharp, so 1 (the physical look) does not blur the face. 0 turns the scattering off.

text.name: fs_fsrenderskinsssradius_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Scale of the skin diffusion profile. 1 is measured human skin (red light spreads about 6 mm, green and blue stay sharp); 1.5 reads well at portrait distance; larger looks softer and waxier.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderskinsssradius
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Scale of the skin diffusion profile. 1 is measured human skin (red light spreads about 6 mm, green and blue stay sharp); 1.5 reads well at portrait distance; larger looks softer and waxier.

text.name: fs_fsrenderskinssstint_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much further red light scatters than green and blue. 1 gives the reddish glow of human skin at shadow edges, 0 a neutral soft blur.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderskinssstint
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much further red light scatters than green and blue. 1 gives the reddish glow of human skin at shadow edges, 0 a neutral soft blur.

text.name: fs_fsrenderskinssstonematch_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 applies scattering to every avatar surface (rigged mesh and the system body), 1 only to surfaces whose colour looks like skin, which keeps it off most clothing. Lower it for non-human or unusually coloured skins.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderskinssstonematch
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 applies scattering to every avatar surface (rigged mesh and the system body), 1 only to surfaces whose colour looks like skin, which keeps it off most clothing. Lower it for non-human or unusually coloured skins.

text.name: fs_fsrenderskinssstranslucency_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Sunlight shining through thin skin lit from behind: ears, fingers and nostrils glow red when the sun is behind the avatar. 1 is the physical amount, 0 is off. Needs sun shadows (thickness is measured in the sun shadow map); the radius above also scales how thick skin can be and still glow.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderskinssstranslucency
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Sunlight shining through thin skin lit from behind: ears, fingers and nostrils glow red when the sun is behind the avatar. 1 is the physical amount, 0 is off. Needs sun shadows (thickness is measured in the sun shadow map); the radius above also scales how thick skin can be and still glow.

check_box.label: Two-pass hair and layered rigged alpha
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderhairtwopass
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Draws alpha-blended rigged mesh (hair, layered clothing) as a depth-sorted solid core and a blended soft fringe, so inner layers stop showing through outer ones. Costs roughly two extra draws of rigged alpha. Rebuilds shaders when changed.

text.name: fs_fsrenderhairalphathreshold_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Alpha at or above which hair counts as solid and is depth sorted. Lower sorts more of each strand but hardens soft edges; higher keeps edges soft but sorts less.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderhairalphathreshold
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Alpha at or above which hair counts as solid and is depth sorted. Lower sorts more of each strand but hardens soft edges; higher keeps edges soft but sorts less.

check_box.label: Refresh visible probes first
check_box.name: fs_fsperfprobeupdatepriority
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Refreshes the reflection probes you can see, and the ones near you, before the ones off screen or far away. Probes that are out of sight still get refreshed, just less often. Off: the standard order.

check_box.label: Skip refreshing unchanged probes
check_box.name: fs_fsperfprobeskipunchanged
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Does not re-render a reflection probe while nothing around it has changed: same sun position and sky light, no objects or terrain near it built or changed. Saves the GPU time of re-rendering the scene for probes in a static scene. Each probe is still refreshed at least every 'Longest time between refreshes', and every probe refreshes when the sky changes.

text.name: fs_fsperfprobemaxstaleseconds_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. With 'Skip refreshing unchanged probes', the longest a probe is left alone even when nothing seems to have changed. Lower catches changes the check misses sooner; higher saves more.

spinner.name: fs_fsperfprobemaxstaleseconds
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. With 'Skip refreshing unchanged probes', the longest a probe is left alone even when nothing seems to have changed. Lower catches changes the check misses sooner; higher saves more.

text.name: fs_fsperfprobesunanglethreshold_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. With 'Skip refreshing unchanged probes', how far the sun or moon may move before probes are refreshed. The default day cycle moves the sun about 1.5 degrees a minute.

spinner.name: fs_fsperfprobesunanglethreshold
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. With 'Skip refreshing unchanged probes', how far the sun or moon may move before probes are refreshed. The default day cycle moves the sun about 1.5 degrees a minute.

text.name: fs_fsperfproberealtimefacesperframe_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. With reflection detail set to Real-time, how many of the six sides of the real-time probe are rendered each frame. 6 is standard. 1 or 2 spreads the work over several frames for a large frame-time saving; the probe updates a little less often but never shows a half-finished cube.

spinner.name: fs_fsperfproberealtimefacesperframe
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. With reflection detail set to Real-time, how many of the six sides of the real-time probe are rendered each frame. 6 is standard. 1 or 2 spreads the work over several frames for a large frame-time saving; the probe updates a little less often but never shows a half-finished cube.

text.name: fs_fsrenderprobefilterquality_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many samples are used to blur probe reflections for rough surfaces. 1 is standard. Higher removes faint ghost copies of bright objects in semi-rough reflections; lower is slightly cheaper and blurrier. Only costs time when a probe finishes updating.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderprobefilterquality
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How many samples are used to blur probe reflections for rough surfaces. 1 is standard. Higher removes faint ghost copies of bright objects in semi-rough reflections; lower is slightly cheaper and blurrier. Only costs time when a probe finishes updating.

text.name: fs_fsrenderprobeblendsmooth_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How softly reflections fade between overlapping reflection probes. 0 is standard (a straight fade); 1 is the smoothest, hiding the visible seam where one probe's area ends and another's begins.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderprobeblendsmooth
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How softly reflections fade between overlapping reflection probes. 0 is standard (a straight fade); 1 is the smoothest, hiding the visible seam where one probe's area ends and another's begins.

check_box.label: Specular occlusion
check_box.name: fs_fsrenderspecularocclusion
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Makes reflections respect ambient occlusion the way a glossy surface really would: reflections inside creases, corners and under objects fade at grazing views, while a reflection looking straight out of an opening stays bright. Works best with Ambient Occlusion enabled or PBR materials that have an occlusion map. Almost no GPU cost.

check_box.label: Normal-map micro-shadows
check_box.name: fs_fsrendermicroshadows
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Lets the fine detail of normal maps (brick, fabric, bark) shadow itself when the sun or a local light comes in at a low angle, for more depth. Needs ambient occlusion: from Ambient Occlusion or a PBR material's occlusion map. Almost no GPU cost.

text.name: fs_fsrenderspecularocclusionstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 keeps the old, plain occlusion of reflections, 1 is the full view-dependent specular occlusion.

spinner.name: fs_fsrenderspecularocclusionstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. 0 keeps the old, plain occlusion of reflections, 1 is the full view-dependent specular occlusion.

text.name: fs_fsrendermicroshadowsstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How strongly normal-map detail shadows itself at low light angles. 0 is none.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendermicroshadowsstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How strongly normal-map detail shadows itself at low light angles. 0 is none.

check_box.label: Cloud shadows
check_box.name: fs_fsrendercloudshadows
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. The sky's clouds cast moving shadows on the ground, objects and avatars. Needs sun shadows.

text.name: fs_fsrendercloudshadowstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much light a full cloud takes away.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendercloudshadowstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much light a full cloud takes away.

text.name: fs_fsrendercloudshadowsoftness_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Softer cloud shadow edges.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendercloudshadowsoftness
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Softer cloud shadow edges.

check_box.label: Contact shadows
check_box.name: fs_fsrendercontactshadows
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Small screen-space shadows where objects touch, which the shadow maps miss (feet on the ground, folds, small props). Needs sun shadows.

text.name: fs_fsrendercontactshadowlength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far towards the sun each pixel looks for an occluder.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendercontactshadowlength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far towards the sun each pixel looks for an occluder.

text.name: fs_fsrendercontactshadowstrength_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Darkness of the contact shadows.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendercontactshadowstrength
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Darkness of the contact shadows.

check_box.label: Coloured shadows through transparent surfaces
check_box.name: fs_fsrendercoloredshadows
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Sunlight passing through stained glass, tinted windows and other alpha-blended surfaces takes on their colour, in proportion to their opacity. Works up to the second sun shadow split (the nearest few tens of metres). Uses two extra textures the size of the shadow maps (about 8 MB each at 1920x1080 with shadow resolution 1) and redraws transparent objects into the two nearest shadow maps. Needs sun shadows.

text.name: fs_fsrendercoloredshadowabsorption_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much light an opaque-looking transparent surface also blocks. 0 only tints the light; 1 lets a fully opaque surface block it completely. Clear glass is unaffected either way.

spinner.name: fs_fsrendercoloredshadowabsorption
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How much light an opaque-looking transparent surface also blocks. 0 only tints the light; 1 lets a fully opaque surface block it completely. Clear glass is unaffected either way.

check_box.label: Also for projector lights
check_box.name: fs_fsrendercoloredshadowsprojectors
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Light from shadowed projectors passing through stained glass, tinted windows and other alpha-blended surfaces takes on their colour too. Uses one extra texture per shadowed projector, the size of its shadow map (up to 16 MB each), and redraws transparent objects into each projector shadow map. Needs coloured shadows and projector shadows (Sun/Moon + Projectors).

panel.name: experimental_textures_settings

check_box.label: Keep decoded textures on disk (faster loading on return visits)
check_box.name: decoded_texture_cache
check_box.tool_tip: Stores the pixels of decoded textures so places you return to load them without JPEG2000 decoding. Uses several times more disk space than the regular texture cache. Cleared together with the texture cache.

combo_box.name: decoded_texture_cache_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: A region can take several GB of decoded textures. Listed regions only keeps just the regions named below. Current region only keeps what you see where you are, so relogging or moving around the same region reuses it, and drops it once you are somewhere else. Places visited before only keeps textures that were already in the texture cache, so a first visit writes nothing.

line_editor.name: decoded_texture_cache_regions
line_editor.tool_tip: Region names, separated by commas. Their decoded textures are kept on any visit, not dropped when you leave, and removed last when the cache is full.

text.name: decoded_texture_cache_min_size_label
text.tool_tip: Textures smaller than this (larger side, in pixels) decode quickly enough and are not kept.

check_box.label: Store uncompressed (faster loading, about 1.5x the disk space)
check_box.name: decoded_texture_cache_uncompressed
check_box.tool_tip: Decompressing is most of the cost of loading from the decoded cache, and texture pixels only compress to about 65%. Applies to newly stored textures.

check_box.label: Decode the most important textures first
check_box.name: prioritize_texture_decodes
check_box.tool_tip: Decodes textures in order of importance instead of request order, so what is in front of you sharpens first after a teleport or while moving. Decodes for textures nothing waits for anymore are skipped.

check_box.label: Run texture decode and cache threads at low priority
check_box.name: low_priority_texture_threads
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Texture decoding and caching only use CPU time the main and render threads leave free. Smoother frames while a scene loads, but loading can take longer on CPUs with few cores.

check_box.label: Use the video memory the driver reports for the texture budget
check_box.name: use_live_vram
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. On NVIDIA and AMD, textures are reduced when the GPU itself is running out of video memory, counting everything else using it, instead of using a fixed share of it. Has no effect when the texture memory limit is set manually.

text.name: texture_bias_soft_zone_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far below the texture memory target textures start being reduced, a little at a time, so memory levels off before it runs out instead of dropping detail all at once. 0.1 starts at 90% of the target. 0 waits until the target is reached.

panel.text: Start reducing textures before memory is full

spinner.name: texture_bias_soft_zone
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. How far below the texture memory target textures start being reduced, a little at a time, so memory levels off before it runs out instead of dropping detail all at once. 0.1 starts at 90% of the target. 0 waits until the target is reached.

check_box.label: Log texture fetch pipeline diagnostics
check_box.name: texture_fetch_pipeline_diagnostics
check_box.tool_tip: Periodically log a texture HTTP pipeline snapshot for diagnosing stalled texture fetches

check_box.label: Recover stalled texture downloads automatically
check_box.name: texture_fetch_self_heal
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. If textures sit waiting for a download slot while no texture downloads are actually running, give the slots back so loading continues. Logged under Texture.

check_box.label: Retry sooner for avatars stuck as a cloud
check_box.name: avatar_cloud_fast_retry
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. When another avatar is missing its shape or body textures, ask the region for its appearance again after 15, 30 and 60 seconds, instead of only every 2 minutes.

check_box.label: Ask again when an avatar's appearance arrives without a shape
check_box.name: avatar_retry_empty_appearance
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. When the region sends another avatar's appearance without a shape, ask for it again right away (at most every 10 seconds) instead of waiting for the cloud timeout.

check_box.label: Ignore out of order appearance updates
check_box.name: avatar_drop_stale_appearance
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. During an outfit change, appearance updates for another avatar can arrive out of order. Ignore one that is older than the last applied, if it arrives within 10 seconds of it. Logged under Avatar.

check_box.label: Reuse rigged mesh joint matrices until the skeleton moves
check_box.name: perf_riggedpalettecache
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Build each rigged mesh's joint matrix palette once per skeleton update and reuse it in every render pass (camera, shadows, probes), instead of rebuilding it for each pass.

check_box.label: Skip unchanged attachment bounding box updates
check_box.name: perf_attachmentextentscache
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Only push a rigged attachment's bounding box into the scene tree when the avatar's bounds actually changed.

check_box.label: Skin rigged meshes once per frame
check_box.name: fs_fsperfskinonceperframe
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Skins rigged mesh avatars, clothing and animesh once per frame and reuses the result in every pass (shadows, reflections, glow, alpha), instead of skinning again in each pass. Helps most in crowds with shadows on. Uses some extra video memory (48 bytes per rigged vertex on screen). Works best with the rigged palette cache. Reloads shaders.

check_box.label: Re-sort transparent faces without rebuilding geometry when the camera turns
check_box.name: perf_alpharesortonly
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. When the camera turns, re-order only the transparent faces of each group for correct blending, instead of rebuilding the group's geometry.

check_box.label: Spread geometry rebuilds over frames and defer off-screen ones
check_box.name: perf_rebuildtimebudget
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Limit how long geometry rebuilds may take each frame and rebuild groups and particles that are off screen only once they come into view.

check_box.label: Fit shadow maps using the camera's visible objects
check_box.name: perf_shadowpointcloudfromcull
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Work out the shadow map bounds from the objects the camera already found visible, instead of searching the scene again for every shadow cascade.

check_box.label: Look for nearby lights 10 times a second
check_box.name: perf_lightrescanthrottle
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Rescan the scene for the nearest local lights 10 times a second, or when the camera moves, instead of every frame.

check_box.label: Skip mirror cube faces that cannot be seen
check_box.name: perf_heroprobeskiphiddenfaces
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Do not render the sides of a mirror's reflection cube that face away from the mirror surface.

check_box.label: Skip the second mirror probe data update in each pass
check_box.name: perf_probeuniformcache
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Do not update the mirror (hero) probe data a second time in each render pass; the reflection probe update already includes it.

check_box.label: Batch local light drawing
check_box.name: fs_fsperfbatchedlocallights
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Draws point lights in a few instanced calls instead of one call per light, cutting CPU time where hundreds of lights are visible (clubs, cities). Lighting should look the same. Spotlights and projectors are unchanged. Rebuilds shaders when changed.

check_box.label: Check sound mute and parcel rules 4 times a second
check_box.name: perf_audiothrottlechecks
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Re-check whether each sound source is muted or allowed by parcel rules 4 times a second, or right away when the mute list, parcel or your position changes, instead of every frame.

check_box.label: Update hidden inventory panels less often
check_box.name: perf_inventoryidlethrottle
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Inventory panels that are not on screen update their folder views twice a second instead of every frame.

check_box.label: Merge shadow draw calls
check_box.name: fs_fsperfshadowmergedbatches
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Sends the opaque shadow casters of each shadow pass as fewer, larger draw calls. Shadows look the same; saves CPU time in scenes with many objects.

check_box.label: Cache static far shadows
check_box.name: fs_fsperfshadowstaticcache
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Keeps the shadows of buildings and terrain in the two far sun shadow maps between frames and only redraws moving things into them. Needs 'Snap sun shadows to texels' (FSRenderShadowTexelSnap). Uses one extra depth buffer per far shadow map.

text.name: fs_fsperfshadowstaticcachesunangle_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. With the static far shadow cache, the far shadows follow the sun in steps of this many degrees, 0 to 2. Larger steps redraw the cache less often under a moving sun.

spinner.name: fs_fsperfshadowstaticcachesunangle
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. With the static far shadow cache, the far shadows follow the sun in steps of this many degrees, 0 to 2. Larger steps redraw the cache less often under a moving sun.

check_box.label: Streamed texture uploads (PBO)
check_box.name: fs_fsperftextureuploadpbo
check_box.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Copies newly loaded textures to the graphics card asynchronously, which can reduce stutter when many textures arrive at once. Only has an effect when textures are not already created on a background thread (usually AMD and Intel graphics). Needs OpenGL 4.4.

text.name: fs_fsperftextureuploadbudgetmb_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Spreads bursts of newly loaded textures over several frames so they don't all land in one frame, uploading the most important ones first. Lower is smoother but textures appear more slowly. 0 = no limit. 16 is a good start.

spinner.name: fs_fsperftextureuploadbudgetmb
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Spreads bursts of newly loaded textures over several frames so they don't all land in one frame, uploading the most important ones first. Lower is smoother but textures appear more slowly. 0 = no limit. 16 is a good start.

text.name: projector_shadow_softness_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Softens projector shadows with distance from the caster; 0 keeps sharp edges, 1 uses the light's prim size.

spinner.name: projector_shadow_softness
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Softens projector shadows with distance from the caster; 0 keeps sharp edges, 1 uses the light's prim size.

text.name: sun_shadow_softness_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Softens sun and moon shadows with distance from the caster; 0 keeps sharp edges, 1 uses the real sun's size.

spinner.name: sun_shadow_softness
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Softens sun and moon shadows with distance from the caster; 0 keeps sharp edges, 1 uses the real sun's size.

text.name: shadow_max_penumbra_label
text.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Caps how soft shadow edges can get; larger values look smoother but cost more.

spinner.name: shadow_max_penumbra
spinner.tool_tip: EXPERIMENTAL. Caps how soft shadow edges can get; larger values look smoother but cost more.
